Delicious restaurant full of Vietnamese culture

The staff are very friendly and helpful, the service is great and the people feel comfortable. The restaurant environment is clean and tidy, the overall design is full of Vietnamese cultural characteristics of classical style, the atmosphere is very warm and elegant. The food is delicious, authentic and delicious, and satisfying. The location of the restaurant is also very convenient and easy to find in Ho Chi Minh City.
